blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Robin Padilla shared on his social media account photos with Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan amid the latter’s ongoing word war with other lawmakers. The photos were taken at the 2026 Association of Southeast Asian Nations-Chinese Business Leaders Summit on Monday evening. “Isang malaking pagkakataon ito upang makausap nang personal ang Ambassador ng China na si Ginoong Jing Quan. Edukado, gentleman, at diretsong kausap ang Ginoong Tsino,” Padilla wrote in his post. (It is a big opportunity to personally talk to China’s Ambassador Mr. Jing Quan. The Chinese man is educated, a gentleman and straightforward.) READ: PH cautions […]... Keep on reading: LOOK: Robin Padilla chats with ‘gentleman’ Chinese ambassador
